result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, including USD 5M cyber coverage for processing Client data, legally required workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. The force majeure provision remains unchanged. However, requiring all coverages to continue for one year after termination and adding an express own-expense requirement go beyond the playbook and are not necessary to reach its position; the post-termination requirement is also awkward as applied to CGL and workers’ compensation. Otherwise, the clause is professionally drafted.
